metadata.case_name: YIP PUN LEUNG v. CHI SHING INDUSTRIAL CO. LTD

plaintiff.occupation_after: operating two moulding machines (moulding machine operator)

injuries.description: Amputation of the three middle fingers of the right hand
source: Shortly after the start of the night shift, his right hand became trapped in the mould, as a result of which the three middle fingers were amputated.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of two or more fingers alone

injuries.description: Toe amputated and transplanted to replace a middle finger (toe transplantation)
source: In February, 1979, one of his toes was transplanted in place of his middle finger, but this operation has not proved very successful, because it is acutely bent and cannot be straightened.
There is no real disability, or suffering, from the toe amputation.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of other single finger

manifestations.description: very little use of his hand
can flex his thumb only through 45%, instead of the normal 80%
can hold a pen, writing is a laborious business
hand serves really only as a steadying influence or fulcrum
acutely bent transplanted toe which cannot be straightened
can walk for an hour and run inefficiently
gets cramp in the calf muscles occasionally and discomfort when he stands for a long time

losses.description: Very limited use of the right hand (can flex thumb only to 45%, writing laborious, hand serves mainly as steadying influence); overall disability assessed at 45%.
Unsightly disfigurement of the hand and an acutely bent transplanted toe that cannot be straightened.
Can walk for an hour and runs inefficiently; occasional calf cramps and discomfort on prolonged standing.

comparable_cases.injury_description: Defined 'serious injury' category; Court held that the general range of awards in this category should be from $60,000 to $80,000.

comparable_cases.case_name: Li Ping-sum v Chan Wai-tong and other
comparable_cases.injury_description: Court held that the figures in Lee Ting-lam should be increased by about 50%.
